leadText: Hana Takeda (Japanese: 武田華 Takeda Hana) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Hana Takeda (Japanese: 武田華 Takeda Hana) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Takeda was born on August 23 in , Japan and became an actress as an adult. She joined , during , where she voiced several roles including a young and Goh's Grookey.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
=====Humans=====
6 year old (JN001)

=====Pokémon=====
Goh's Grookey

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
Keisuke Hirose (A Silent Voice)
Loly (Bleach)
Deneve (Claymore)
Cheripha (Valkyrie Profile: Covenant of the Plume)
Chowder (Chowder)
Chuukou Kyocho (Ikki Tousen Xtreme Xecutor)
Kurotsuchi (Naruto)
Meena Paroom (Cory in the House)
Misaki Tanabe (Wonder Egg Priority)
Norman (ParaNorman)
Pegitan (Healin' Good♡Pretty Cure)
Seonhee (Like a Dragon series)
